RV & Trailer Recovery for Different Situations

An RV or trailer can require a different recovery approach from a standard car. The vehicle may be larger, longer or heavier, while the trailer may also be connected to another vehicle or positioned somewhere that makes access more difficult.

Recovery may be required when:

  • An RV or motorhome will not start
  • A caravan or trailer cannot be moved
  • A vehicle has suffered mechanical problems
  • An RV has been involved in an accident
  • A trailer has damaged wheels or tyres
  • A recreational vehicle needs transporting
  • A motorhome needs moving to a garage
  • A caravan needs relocating after a breakdown
  • A non-running vehicle needs to be collected
  • An RV or trailer needs to be moved from one location to another

Before arranging recovery, it is useful to explain the vehicle type, its condition and where it is located. This helps determine the most practical way to handle the recovery.

Motorhome & RV Breakdown Recovery Birmingham

Motorhomes and RVs can be difficult to deal with when they develop a fault away from home. Their size and layout can make roadside recovery different from recovering a normal car.

If your motorhome has stopped running, will not start or has developed a problem that makes it unsafe to continue driving, recovery may be the safest option.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery can assist with recovery requirements in Birmingham and surrounding areas. Depending on the situation, the vehicle may need to be transported to:

If you are unsure whether your RV or motorhome can be recovered, contact us and provide the vehicle details and your current location.

  • A suitable garage
  • Your home address
  • A repair centre
  • A storage location
  • Another agreed destination

GOOD TO KNOW

When Do You Need RV or Trailer Recovery?

Not every problem requires the same type of recovery. An RV or trailer may need recovery when it cannot safely continue its journey or cannot be moved using its normal towing arrangement.

Common situations include:

Breakdown

An RV or motorhome may develop an engine, electrical or mechanical fault and become unable to continue.

Tyre or Wheel Problems

A damaged tyre or wheel can prevent a caravan or trailer from being safely moved.

Accident Damage

After an accident, an RV, motorhome or trailer may need to be recovered rather than driven or towed normally.

Non-Running Vehicle

If an RV or motorhome will not start, transportation may be required to move it to a suitable location.

Planned Transportation

Recovery support may also be useful when a recreational vehicle needs to be moved between a home, garage, storage location or another destination.

What Information Should You Provide When Calling?

RV and trailer recovery can be easier to arrange when the recovery team has the right information from the start.

When contacting A.A.D Transport & Recovery, try to provide:

1. Your exact location Tell us where the RV, motorhome, caravan or trailer is currently located.

2. Vehicle type Let us know whether it is an RV, motorhome, caravan, campervan or trailer.

3. What has happened Explain whether it is a breakdown, accident, tyre problem, non-start or another issue.

4. Vehicle condition Tell us whether the vehicle can start, roll, steer or move.

5. Destination Let us know whether you need the vehicle taken to a garage, home, storage facility or another location.

6. Access information If the vehicle is in a narrow street, driveway, car park or other restricted location, mention this when calling.

This information can help the team understand the recovery requirements before arranging transportation.

The vehicle can then be transported to the agreed location, such as a garage, home, storage facility or another suitable destination.

Why Professional RV & Trailer Recovery Matters

Larger recreational vehicles and trailers require more consideration during recovery than an ordinary car. Their dimensions, weight, towing arrangement and access requirements can all affect how the vehicle should be moved.

Trying to move a damaged or non-running RV or trailer without suitable recovery equipment may create additional risks or damage.

Professional recovery support can help ensure that:

  • The vehicle’s condition is considered before moving it
  • Access requirements are discussed
  • The destination is confirmed
  • Recovery requirements are understood in advance
  • The vehicle is transported with appropriate care
  • Customers have a clear understanding of the next step

If you are unsure how your RV or trailer should be recovered, speak to the recovery team before attempting to move it yourself.

24/7 RV & Trailer Recovery Support

Vehicle problems do not always happen during convenient hours. An RV or trailer can break down while travelling, returning from a trip or parked away from home.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 recovery support, allowing customers to contact the team when they need assistance.

Whether your motorhome has stopped working, your caravan cannot be moved or your trailer needs transportation, explain the situation and provide your location so the recovery requirements can be discussed.

RV & Trailer Recovery vs Standard Car Recovery

Recovering an RV or trailer can involve additional considerations because of the vehicle’s size, dimensions and towing configuration.

A standard car may be relatively straightforward to load and transport, while an RV, motorhome or trailer may require more attention to:

Safe Steps While Waiting for RV or Trailer Recovery

If your RV or towing vehicle has broken down on the road, focus on staying safe while waiting for assistance.

Switch on your hazard lights

Move to a safe location away from moving traffic

Keep passengers away from the road

Avoid attempting repairs in a dangerous location

Do not continue driving if the vehicle is unsafe

Give the recovery team your exact location

Follow instructions from emergency services or road authorities

If you are in immediate danger, contact the emergency services first.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have a question? Call us any time — day or night.

Call Now: 07771 004242

Can you recover a motorhome in Birmingham?

Yes. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides recovery and transportation support for motorhomes in Birmingham and surrounding areas. If your motorhome has broken down, cannot start or is unsafe to drive, contact the team with your location and vehicle details so the recovery requirements can be discussed.

Do you provide caravan recovery in Birmingham?

Yes. Caravan recovery can be arranged for situations where a caravan cannot be safely moved or needs transportation to another location. Provide details about the caravan, its condition, location and destination when contacting A.A.D Transport & Recovery.

Can you recover a trailer that cannot move?

A trailer that cannot move may require specialist recovery or transportation depending on its condition and location. Tell the recovery team whether the wheels can move, whether the trailer is connected to another vehicle and where it needs to go.

Can you recover a non-running RV?

Yes, recovery may be required when an RV or motorhome will not start or cannot safely continue its journey. The recovery arrangement will depend on the vehicle’s condition, size, location and access.

Can you transport an RV to a garage?

Yes. If your RV, motorhome or other recreational vehicle needs to be moved to a garage or repair location, A.A.D Transport & Recovery can discuss the transportation requirements and destination with you.

Do you provide 24/7 RV and trailer recovery?

A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 recovery support. If your RV, motorhome, caravan or trailer develops a problem outside normal working hours, contact the team to discuss your recovery requirements.

What details do I need when requesting RV or trailer recovery?

Provide your current location, vehicle type, description of the problem, vehicle condition and required destination. It is also helpful to mention whether the vehicle can start, roll or steer and whether there are any access restrictions.

Can you recover an RV after an accident?

Yes, accident-damaged RVs or motorhomes may require recovery if they cannot safely be driven. Tell the team about the accident, vehicle condition and location so the appropriate recovery requirements can be discussed.

Do you provide trailer transportation as well as emergency recovery?

Recovery and transportation requirements can both be discussed with A.A.D Transport & Recovery. This can be useful when a trailer or recreational vehicle needs to be moved between locations rather than recovered from an immediate breakdown.

What areas do you cover?

A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides recovery services across Birmingham and surrounding areas. If your RV or trailer is located outside Birmingham or needs to be transported elsewhere, contact the team with the collection and destination details to confirm availability.

  • A trailer has damaged wheels or tyres

  • A caravan needs relocating after a breakdown

Trying to move a damaged or non-running RV or trailer without suitable recovery equipment may create additional risks or damage.

Professional recovery support can help ensure that:

  • The vehicle's condition is considered before moving it
  • Access requirements are discussed
  • The destination is confirmed
  • Recovery requirements are understood in advance
  • The vehicle is transported with appropriate care
  • Customers have a clear understanding of the next step

If you are unsure how your RV or trailer should be recovered, speak to the recovery team before attempting to move it yourself.

24/7 RV & Trailer Recovery Support

Vehicle problems do not always happen during convenient hours. An RV or trailer can break down while travelling, returning from a trip or parked away from home.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 recovery support, allowing customers to contact the team when they need assistance.

Whether your motorhome has stopped working, your caravan cannot be moved or your trailer needs transportation, explain the situation and provide your location so the recovery requirements can be discussed.
